fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Shortened CD-road weave carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year peak volume with residual loop traffic merging into new terminal traffic is a substantive, well-recognised preliminary-design-stage sideswipe/rear-end exposure concern for vehicle occupants.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim that PIARC motorway checklists apply at preliminary design is backed by the verbatim EV-IN-004 quote listing 'checklists for motorways ... at each of the design stages (feasibility study, preliminary design, ...)', while the reduced weave length and 1,100 pcu/h volume are recorded input facts from GA drawings and traffic data.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Finding stays within the qualified int:preliminary-design PIARC baseline, frames the item as a safety_concern verified through the audit checklist rather than a compliance mandate, and stages the action correctly ('now, at preliminary design'); HSM Part C/IHSDM appear only as optional analytical aids, not imported norms.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and tiered: apply the named PIARC checklist, run HSM Part C interchange models or IHSDM evaluation, and conditionally lengthen the weave or add ramp metering — concrete, actionable, and viable at preliminary design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Not applicable since shared-use paths are grade-separated from the motorised weaving section, but the finding explicitly acknowledges this and scopes road users to vehicle occupants, earning the capped acknowledgement score.

justifications.substance: Free-flow ramp entries at retained loops leaving uncontrolled shared-use-path crossings directly contradicts recorded VRU-continuity objectives and is a genuine, well-recognised interchange safety issue addressable at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim rests on recorded scheme objectives/layout plus a verbatim EV-IN-005 quote mandating non-motorised user consideration; only the 'northern' loop descriptor is a minor extrapolation beyond the recorded text.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern (design opportunity to improve safety) rather than a compliance breach, appropriate to the qualified PIARC-derived international baseline at preliminary-design stage.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Highly actionable: names specific interfaces (northern loop-ramp crossing, both retained terminals), named PIARC tools (Walkability Checklist, CQSI), and viable treatments (signalised or grade-separated) suited to design stage.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus throughout—road_users, category, scenario, and recommendation all centre on VRU impacts at the ramp-terminal crossings.
